title: Rapid stabilization for Stokes and Navier-Stokes systems with localized disturbance
summary: In this study, we analyze the rapid stabilization of Stokes and the two- and three-dimensional Navier-Stokes systems in the presence of an unknown spatially localized disturbance. A multivalued feedback control strategy is proposed which combines the Lyapunov frequency method with the multivalued sign operator. This methodology connects Lyapunov-based stability analysis with spectral inequalities, while the inclusion of the sign operator provides robustness against disturbance.
